title: DNA recovery from filter paper
author: Diego Bonatto
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.u8iezue
materials: Immerse the circle in 30 µL of TE buffer Invitrogen - Thermo Fisher and pipette to mix.

steps.title: Cut DNA circle from filter
steps.instruction: Using a clean razor blade, cut out one of the circles on the filter paper that contains your plasmid DNA.

steps.title: Incubate then transform bacteria
steps.instruction: After waiting at least 00:10:00 (10 minutes), add 2 µL of the recovered plasmid to competent bacteria for transformation.
